mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_notification_log ( application_id, research_no, channel_type, target_address_masked, keyword_summary, send_status, fail_reason ) VALUES ( #{applicationId}, #{researchNo}, #{channelType}, #{targetAddressMasked}, #{keywordSummary}, #{sendStatus}, #{failReason} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, application_id, research_no, channel_type, target_address_masked, keyword_summary, send_status, fail_reason, created_at FROM admin_notification_log WHERE research_no = #{researchNo} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT id, application_id, research_no, channel_type, target_address_masked, keyword_summary, send_status, fail_reason, created_at FROM admin_notification_log ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, application_id, research_no, channel_type, target_address_masked, keyword_summary, send_status, fail_reason, created_at FROM admin_notification_log ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT channel_type AS channelType, SUM(CASE WHEN send_status = 'SENT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sentCount, SUM(CASE WHEN send_status = 'SKIPPED_DUPLICATE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS skippedDuplicateCount, SUM(CASE WHEN send_status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failedCount, MAX(created_at) AS latestCreatedAt FROM admin_notification_log WHERE research_no = #{researchNo} AND channel_type IN ('LEGACY_SMS', 'LEGACY_EMAIL') GROUP BY channel_type ORDER BY latestCreatedAt DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') AS monthKey, COUNT(*) AS sentCount FROM admin_notification_log WHERE send_status = 'SENT' AND channel_type = 'LEGACY_SMS' AND created_at >= #{startDate} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY monthKey ASC
